what_it_is.prose: Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) is an Israeli state-owned defence OEM headquartered at Ben Gurion International Airport. IAI's ELTA Systems division is a leading radar, electronic warfare, and UAV supplier. IAI has a major India footprint across multiple programmes. IAI is a co-developer (with DRDO) of the MRSAM/LR-SAM (Barak-8) family — the Indian Navy signed a $777 million contract for maritime Barak-8 and a $630 million LRSAM contract for 4 Indian Navy ships. The EL/M-2248 MF-STAR multi-function surveillance radar (450 km range, naval AESA) is fitted on the P15B Visakhapatnam-class destroyers (4 ships commissioned 2021-2024) and the P17A Nilgiri-class frigates (7 ships under construction). India is the largest UAV customer outside Israel for IAI — the Indian Army, Navy, and IAF operate the Searcher Mk II, Heron, and Heron TP UAVs. The Indian Navy received its first Heron Mk II under emergency procurement in December 2025. A HAL-IAI Heron TP India manufacturing deal was under negotiation as of December 2025 (per Eurasian Times). IAI maintains a full India subsidiary — IAI India Private Limited (New Delhi) — with R&D, manufacturing, training, and support capabilities.

faq.question: What is the relationship between IAI and DRDO on the Barak-8 programme?
faq.answer: IAI and DRDO co-developed the Barak-8 (MRSAM/LR-SAM) missile family under a strategic partnership. DRDO provides the inertial navigation, mission software, and mobile launchers; IAI/ELTA provides the active radar seeker and key missile components. Indian production is via BEL (radar, C4I) and BDL (missile). The Indian Navy signed a $777 million contract for maritime Barak-8 and a $630 million LRSAM contract for 4 ships.

faq.question: Which Indian Navy ships use the IAI MF-STAR radar?
faq.answer: The EL/M-2248 MF-STAR (Multi-Function Surveillance, Track and Guidance) naval AESA radar with 450 km range equips the P15B Visakhapatnam-class destroyers (4 ships: INS Visakhapatnam, Mormugao, Imphal, Surat — all commissioned 2021-2024) and the P17A Nilgiri-class frigates (7 ships under construction at MDL Mumbai and GRSE Kolkata). The radar provides the fire control for the Barak-8/LR-SAM air defence system.

faq.question: Does India manufacture IAI UAVs?
faq.answer: India is in negotiations with IAI for Heron TP manufacturing under a HAL-IAI deal (reported December 2025 by Eurasian Times), but the deal has not been finalised. India does manufacture the IAI Hermes 900 (designated Drishti 10 Starliner in Indian Navy service) under the Adani-Elbit JV at Hyderabad — see Atlas slug mfg-032 (Elbit Systems). The Heron TP itself is not yet manufactured in India.
